description: RISK R-B, STATED FIRST BECAUSE THE CLASS NAME INVERTS THE BEHAVIOUR: the prompt-mandated Java class for COTRN02C is TransactionViewController, but this program does not view - it ADDS. Two independent artefacts say so: app/cbl/COTRN02C.cbl:5 'Function    : Add a new Transaction to TRANSACT file', and README.md:222 '| CT02 | COTRN02 | COTRN02C | Transaction Add |', which is the exact inverse of the prompt's mapping and the mirror image of parity/COTRN01C, whose program genuinely views and whose class is named TransactionAddController. Rule R1 governs the resolution - the name comes from the prompt, the behaviour comes from the source - and practice B4 governs the disclosure, so the divergence is documented here and never silently corrected; the Agent Action Plan escalates it for explicit user confirmation, and nothing here guesses which artefact is authoritative about intent, only about behaviour, where the source is the only oracle there is. No case in this folder is downgraded to read-only to match the name: the EXEC CICS WRITE at :713 is pinned at its full 350 bytes by case19 and case20. WHAT THIS CASE PINS: first entry carrying no selection - MAIN-PARA's NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER guard at app/cbl/COTRN02C.cbl:120, the path that paints an empty add screen and asks for input. A 218-byte area travelled, so unlike case01 the ELSE arm at :118 is taken and :119 MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) TO CARDDEMO-COMMAREA runs, making the area this case declares the program's own. CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives at '0', so the 88-level CDEMO-PGM-REENTER that app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy gives VALUE 1 is false and the guard is taken: :121 SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER TO TRUE arms the next call, :122 MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COTRN2AO blanks the whole output map to X'00' - which is why fourteen of the twenty-one output items are reported as low-values rather than as spaces, the seven written over being the six header items and ERRMSGO - and :123 MOVE -1 TO ACTIDINL OF COTRN2AI asks for the cursor on the account field, which is the only reason a cursor field is named at all. CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED arrives blank, so the test at :124-125 against SPACES AND LOW-VALUES is false, PROCESS-ENTER-KEY is skipped, and nothing is validated, resolved or written. :130 PERFORM SEND-TRNADD-SCREEN then paints once and ends the task itself at :530-534 with EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID), which is why the termination is RETURN_TRANSID and the next program is this one rather than another; the EXEC CICS RETURN written at :156-159 is byte for byte that same statement and is unreachable for exactly that reason. EIBAID is never read on this path, because :120 diverts before the EVALUATE at :133, so no aid is declared - declaring one would suggest the key mattered. WHAT IS PAINTED, AND WHERE EACH BYTE COMES FROM: SEND-TRNADD-SCREEN performs POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :518, and :552-571 fills exactly six of the twenty-one output items. TITLE01O and TITLE02O are the 40-byte literals app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy declares, TRNNAMEO is WS-TRANID 'CT02' from :37 and PGMNAMEO is WS-PGMNAME 'COTRN02C' from :36, and CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are built through app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy's WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY and WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS group items, whose embedded FILLER separators make them MM/DD/YY and HH:MM:SS rather than raw digits. :520 MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO then loses two bytes on the way from a PIC X(80) working-storage field into a PIC X(78) screen field, which is why ERRMSGO is pinned at 78 blanks while the WS_MESSAGE_80 channel is pinned at 80: that truncation is the behaviour, not a rounding of it. ERRMSGC is pinned at DFHDFCOL, the map's default colour, because the single attribute byte this program ever assigns is the DFHGREEN at :727 on the confirmed-insert path, which this case does not reach. All twenty-one output items are pinned and none omitted, because an unpinned field is a field nobody has checked. PROGRAM-SET VERSUS CARRIED THROUGH, STATED EXPLICITLY (practice B8): of the 22 fields in the outbound area, exactly ONE is program-set on this path - CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT, which :121 moves from '0' to '1' so that the next call takes the re-enter arm at :131 instead of repainting. Six are CARRIED THROUGH byte for byte from the inbound area and are never touched here: CDEMO-FROM-TRANID 'CT00', CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM 'COTRN00C', CDEMO-TO-TRANID 'CT02', CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM 'COTRN02C', CDEMO-USER-ID 'USER0001' and CDEMO-USER-TYPE 'U' - the last being the 88-level CDEMO-USRTYP-USER rather than the ADMIN 'A'. The remaining fifteen arrive at their initial state because this case's inbound area does not declare them, and the program writes none of them: blanks for the PIC X items CDEMO-CUST-FNAME, CDEMO-CUST-MNAME, CDEMO-CUST-LNAME, CDEMO-ACCT-STATUS, CDEMO-LAST-MAP, CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET, CDEMO-CT02-TRNID-FIRST, CDEMO-CT02-TRNID-LAST, CDEMO-CT02-NEXT-PAGE-FLG, CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SEL-FLG and CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED, and zeros for the PIC 9 items CDEMO-CUST-ID, CDEMO-ACCT-ID, CDEMO-CARD-NUM and CDEMO-CT02-PAGE-NUM (rule R5: PIC X space-padded, PIC 9 zero-filled). One of those fifteen is worth naming on its own. CDEMO-CT02-NEXT-PAGE-FLG is the single field :76 gives a VALUE clause, VALUE 'N', and it is pinned here as a BLANK, not as 'N' - because :119 overwrites the whole 218-byte area with what arrived, so a WORKING-STORAGE VALUE clause survives only on the path where :119 never runs. That is precisely case01, where the same field is pinned at 'N'. The two cases disagreeing about that one byte is the correct outcome, and stating why is cheaper than rediscovering it from a diff. THE TWO DATASETS THIS CASE SEEDS, AND WHY: three TRANSACT rows are declared inline because no ASCII fixture ships for that master - it is populated online rather than loaded - and each is 350 bytes summed from app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy as 16+2+4+10+100+11+9+50+50+10+16+26+26 +20, with the trailing FILLER PIC X(20) present and space-filled (gates G19 and G21). All three stand byte-identical on the final-state channel, which is the positive form of 'this path writes nothing': the backward browse at :644-704 and the WRITE at :713 sit inside PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, which :124 declined to perform, and TRANSACT has no REWRITE and no DELETE anywhere in the codebase, so expectedWrites is empty and the master still holds exactly three rows of exactly 350 bytes. Row 0 is additionally pinned across all fourteen CVTRA05Y spans by their verbatim copybook names, FILLER included, so that a codec which silently dropped or shifted a span would be caught by name and not only by total width; TRAN-AMT is stated as its eleven-byte stored image 0000000010A rather than as a quantity, because the gate is byte parity and the zoned sign overpunch that makes it +1.01 is part of the value. CCXREF is seeded from five rows of the cardxref.txt fixture exactly as they ship, 36 bytes wide, and is deliberately NOT pre-padded: app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy declares CARD-XREF-RECORD as 16+9+11+14 = 50 and the fixture omits the trailing FILLER PIC X(14), so the CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50 normalisation declared below supplies those fourteen spaces once, at seed time, and is the sole owner of that repair (gate G16, risk R-F). It is seeded even though this path never reads it, because the cross-reference is the collaborator the controller is constructed with on every case and a case that named no rows for it would be describing a differently wired unit. CXACAIX is not seeded as a dataset of its own: app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD defines it as a PATH over the CCXREF base, so both cross-reference finders answer from the one seeded base cluster and never from a second table (gate G45). Every dataset is addressed by its application.yml binding key rather than by name, so not one fully-qualified mainframe dataset name appears anywhere in this file (gate G46); no tenth fixture is named - the fixture set is closed at the nine derived from app/data/ASCII - and the code page is stated as US-ASCII rather than left to a platform default (practice B8). DEAD DECLARATIONS PRESERVED, NOT TIDIED (practice B5): WS-ACCTDAT-FILE PIC X(08) VALUE 'ACCTDAT ' is declared at :40 and COPY CVACT01Y at :89, and neither is referenced anywhere in the program's 783 lines - no DATASET operand names WS-ACCTDAT-FILE and no field of ACCOUNT-RECORD is ever moved - so the account master is a dead declaration and its copybook a dead include. The eleven EXEC CICS verbs are RETURN(156), XCTL(508), SEND(522), RETURN(530), RECEIVE(541), READ CXACAIX(578), READ CCXREF(611), STARTBR(644), READPREV(675), ENDBR(704) and WRITE(713): four datasets are named by the program and only two are ever touched. No ACCTDAT input is therefore declared here, and no case in this folder may expect an ACCTDAT read or place an ACCTDAT row in an expectation - ParityHarness.seed states that the inputs member names every dataset the unit under test will read, so seeding a master the program never opens would assert a read that does not exist, which is a false expectation dressed as a thorough one. The deadness is asserted as the non-event it is: both names stay constants, no account collaborator is wired at all, and COTRN02CParityTest.DeadDeclarations proves it independently of any case. CASE ALLOCATION, RECONCILED IN THE OPEN (practice B4): this file's authoring brief described case02 as the EIBCALEN = 0 sign-on route. That route is already pinned by case01, and has been since this folder was first written - case01 declares eibcalen 0, nextProgram 'COSGN00C' and termination XCTL, and its own description records the same reconciliation from the other side, stating that the first-entry paint 'is already pinned byte for byte by case02'. Re-encoding the guard here would therefore have produced two semantically identical cases while deleting the only case that drives the NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER arm at :120, and there is nowhere to move that arm to: ParityHarness.casesOf enumerates exactly case01 through case20 and refuses a stray file, so the twenty slots are full and every one of them already carries a distinct behaviour (case03 first entry carrying a selection, case04 and case05 the two branches of the DFHPF3 arm, case06 WHEN OTHER of the EVALUATE, case07 to case18 the validation surface, case19 and case20 the insert). COTRN02CParityTest's own class documentation lists what the twenty must drive between them and names both the EIBCALEN = 0 guard AND 'first entry with and without a selection', so both have to exist; honouring the brief's case number literally would have satisfied a sentence while breaking the requirement. The Agent Action Plan takes precedence, its purpose for twenty cases is branch coverage, and the divergence is recorded here rather than made silently: nothing is renamed, no expectation is weakened, and every binding requirement of the brief that this path can carry holds on it - CONTROLLER_POJO with no HTTP, no job parameter, empty writes, return code 0, no error text, binding keys only, an unpadded cardxref seed, no CXACAIX table, no tenth fixture, a pinned clock and offset-summed widths. The one requirement this path cannot carry is the XCTL translation, and that is stated plainly rather than faked: RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN is not performed here, so the nextProgram field pinned below is the TRANSID target of the EXEC CICS RETURN at :531 and not the operand of an EXEC CICS XCTL. Gate G40 is discharged by case01 at :508-511 and by case04 and case05 through the :143 arm. BASELINE PROVENANCE (practice B12): every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED - by structured reading of MAIN-PARA, SEND-TRNADD-SCREEN and POPULATE-HEADER-INFO, cross-checked against the copybook byte layouts (app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy summed field by field as 4+8+4+8+8+1+1+9+25+25+25+11+1+16+7+7 = 160 bytes, and the CDEMO-CT02-INFO extension the program appends at :72-80 as 16+16+8+1+1+16 = 58, so the area that travels is 218 bytes in 22 fields; app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy 350; app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy 50; app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy 300, whose misspelled ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE would be preserved verbatim by any case that pinned it), against the symbolic-map widths of app/cpy-bms/COTRN02.CPY (21 output items, ERRMSGO PIC X(78); the length, flag and attribute items beside each are metadata and are never payload), and against the real bytes of app/data/ASCII. It was NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution: running the legacy programs is empirically impossible in this environment, which Agent Action Plan section 0.7.6 establishes with eight independently verified blockers - among them a compiler whose indexed-file handler is disabled, the absence of any Language Environment CEE service behind CSUTLDTC, the absence of a CICS emulator, and the absence of the IBM-supplied DFHAID and DFHBMSCA copybooks this program copies at :92-93 - and the change of provenance is escalated as risk R-A rather than absorbed silently. Because a statically derived expectation can encode a misreading where a captured one cannot, every width above is summed from a PICTURE clause rather than asserted from memory (practice B11). NO USER RULES EXIST: review_rules returns exactly one line, 'No user rules provided', and that line is the whole document, so no rule forces this file into scope and no rule constrains how it is written. Per UR4 the absence is stated explicitly and is not treated as permission to lower the bar: the standard held here is the Agent Action Plan section 0.10.2 enterprise practices, cited by name where they bite - B1 (every literal derived from a PICTURE clause, a VALUE clause or a fixture row, with no placeholder anywhere), B3 (the reference trees app/cbl, app/cpy, app/cpy-bms, app/bms, app/csd and app/data are read-only and were not touched), B4 (both the R-B inversion and the case allocation disclosed rather than corrected), B5 (dead declarations preserved and asserted as non-events), B7 (a pinned clock, never a captured now, so the run is reproducible in any timezone), B8 (binding keys, a named code page, explicit per-field expectations and an explicit program-set versus carried-through statement), B11 (every width summed mechanically) and B12 (the provenance statement above). Rules R1, R5 and R6 bind as well: the name from the prompt with the behaviour from the source, the fixed-width wire format, and statelessness. GATES DISCHARGED: G15 (one of exactly twenty cases in parity/COTRN02C), G16 (the cardxref seed stays 36 bytes and is normalised at seed time, never pre-padded), G18 (the diff count must be zero, per module rather than per build), G19 and G21 (350-byte records whose FILLER is present and space-filled, proven by the named spans on row 0 as well as by the whole image on all three), G30 (the ordered EVALUATE EIBAID at :133-152 is not reached on this path, because :120 diverts before it, and its arms are driven by case04 through case07 - so order is preserved here by not asserting an arm this path cannot take), G37 (no server-side session state: the whole 218-byte area arrives in the request and leaves in the response, and COTRN02CParityTest proves the controller keeps nothing between runs), G45 (CXACAIX is an alternate-index finder over the CCXREF base, not a second table), G46 (binding keys, never a dataset-name literal) and G51 (the controller is driven as a plain object - no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container and no HTTP in the path). G38 is satisfied in its ENTER half here: this is the CDEMO-PGM-ENTER state, the CSSETATY highlight applies only in the REENTER state, and this screen assigns no field attribute in either - the REENTER half belongs to case04 onwards. G40 is discharged by case01, case04 and case05 for the reason given above. DELIBERATELY NOT ASSERTED, because COTRN02C has none of them: G32 (zero GO TO, so no backward jump to restructure), G35 (zero CALL 'CEE3ABD', which is why the return code is 0 and no abend path exists), G39 (no pagination loop) and G43 (no 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC).
